caption: A power cut hits a kitchen, and the fridge hum stops, the oven clock goes blank and the ceiling light goes out all at once.

sa.check: A kitchen with its ceiling light lit and an oven whose clock display is lit.
The light and the clock go off at the same moment.

pc.expect: The ceiling light and the oven clock go dark at the same moment.
pc.fail: The light goes out and the clock stays lit to the end of the clip; or the clock goes blank while the light stays on; or the light goes out first and the clock goes blank only later; or a lit display on the fridge stays lit after the light and clock have gone dark.

pc.expect: The kitchen's contents are the same before and after the cut: the same fridge, oven and furniture in the same places, whether seen dim or lit again.
pc.fail: Items on the counters appear or vanish between the lit and dark frames; or the fridge or oven changes place; or a lit window or lamp appears in the dark that was not there before.

pc.expect: When the ceiling light goes out the room darkens with it: light from the fixture leaves the walls and floor, and whatever light remains comes from windows or sources present before.
pc.fail: The fixture goes dark while the room stays as bright; or the room darkens while the fixture still glows; or light stays pooled under the dark fixture.

pc.expect: Once off, the light and the clock stay off; if power returns they come back together.
pc.fail: The light comes back while the clock stays blank to the end of the clip; or the clock comes back while the light stays out; or the light switches on and off repeatedly while the clock stays blank.

pc.expect: The fridge, oven, cabinets and fixture keep their shapes; the fixture stays on the ceiling and nothing passes through a wall or counter.
pc.fail: The fixture drops or vanishes rather than going dark; or an appliance or cabinet changes shape; or a hand or object passes through a counter or wall.

pc.expect: Wall and cabinet colours and the items on the counters stay the same apart from brightness.
pc.fail: Cabinets change colour rather than brightness; or the oven's control layout changes; or items on the counter change colour.

note: The fridge hum is sound and is not judged; the fridge counts only through any lit display or indicator it has. The moment of the cut is read from the light and the clock going dark.
